about: Sub-tests the v2 backend suite skips, by exact name, each with its reason. tools/backend-tests.js passes them to node --test-skip-pattern for their own file only. Everything else in the file runs.

adr-spark.test.js.name: the record exists where a reader would look for it
it carries every section the other records carry
it takes a position and names what it replaces
ADR-006 says it was superseded, and by what
EVERY claim the record rests on is still true of the code
it says what would change the answer, in checkable terms

capture-affordance.test.js.name: the iOS bundle is re-synced, or the phone runs a page without the change

fcc-previz-capture.test.js.name: EVERY mode gets the WORLD budget the server computes, not the footage one
a walkthrough is SHORTER than the same mode shot for the cut
the recommendation for a WORLD capture is chosen against Marble
EVERY forWorld entry point is actually asked with it
the camera knows whether THIS session is a world capture
a world take LOCKS exposure, rather than hoping a director remembered
a lens that cannot hold exposure is NAMED, and the take still runs
a finished walkthrough is DELIVERED to the route the page named
a delivery that fails NAMES itself and keeps the take
the iOS bundle is re-synced, or the phone runs a page without the change

film-engine-camera-brief.test.js.name: the brief exists and carries every section the format asks for
EVERY claim the brief rests on is still true of the code
the brief states the framing error rather than burying it
the size comparison that carries the recommendation is stated with BOTH numbers
the open questions are DECISIONS, not tasks in disguise

drop-to-recipe.test.js.name: the canvas accepts dropped files, hashes them in the browser, asks /match, and opens the recipe or offers the upload

flow-outputs.test.js.name: the page draws every drawn kind off its shot: the real node renderer, the badge and the drawer strip

flow-pick.test.js.name: the drawer offers Pick on each awaiting variation and Cancel on its run

flow-form.test.js.name: the drawer renders the form, every control, and the plan it confirms carries the values

flow-provenance.test.js.name: the panel names the flow, and "make another" re-applies that flow to the shot through the apply

flow-queue.test.js.name: the strip draws the paused bucket, with a way to the pick and a Cancel run on each live flow run

flow-next-node.test.js.name: releasing a wire on empty canvas opens the suggestions; picking one adds the node there, wired

flow-canvas-reach.test.js.name: with the graph on, the Flows page is reachable by address, with no back button when not arriving from the graph

flows-on-graph-docs.test.js.name: CLAUDE.md has the section, and it names every task the code cites
the Word guide carries every task a director meets, and lists it in the contents

graph-templates-shelf.test.js.name: the palette reads the shelf when it opens, and the iOS copy carries it

graph-add-palette.test.js.name: keyboard only: arrows move, Enter picks, Escape cancels; a double-click on empty canvas opens it; Shift+click picks shots

graph-patterns.test.js.name: the add palette offers every pattern after the nearest shot; Enter previews for free, a second Enter creates

graph-collapse.test.js.name: the page draws a collapsed group as a card with every summary field, hides its members, and toggles through the route

how-made-panel.test.js.name: the drawers wire it in: version drawer and shot drawer load the recipe, offer make-another and compare-with-selected

graph-hold.test.js.name: a held node wears a "held" badge; nothing else does; Ctrl+B and the menu reach the toggle

redo-between-frames-brief.test.js.name: the brief states the constraints that decide the design

redo-between-frames-epic.test.js.name: every section the template mandates is present
every declared task is well formed
the epic states the constraints that decide the design

screenplay-port.test.js.name: the plan accounts for every element the parser can emit
the plan states the coverage counts, and they are true
the plan defines authorability rather than just counting it
every element the plan calls stranded really is known-but-unreachable
the plan and the FDX map agree about what is exported
the MCP screenplay surface is what the plan says it is
the plan names its phases, its deferrals and who owns the unverified cells

storage-never-throws.test.js.name: the app injects the address by a route that cannot throw

music-registries.test.js.name: every track role: stored through the tool, rendered or named a guide with its reason, documented
every clip kind: stored, rendered when selected, walked by the rights lineage, documented
every kind of file the workstation registers is documented
every score tool reaches a route the router names and the API reference documents
every section of the portable package is in a built manifest and in the documentation
every DAW mutation has an agent tool, a page control with its portable twin, an audit record, and documentation

video-editorial-ui.test.js.name: desktop and packaged mobile UI compile and stay identical

room-scan.test.js.name: the iPhone app scans with RoomPlan and the page asks it under the same names
the phone files a photo to the wall it faces, worked out from the scan (compiled and run where Swift is here)

world-blender-import.test.js.name: walking moves the shot's own camera, and keeping it goes through the validated proposal
world-blender-import.test.js.reason: PRE-EXISTING: fails in film-engine at the pinned commit too

set-build.test.js.name: the Previs Plan view edits the set: footprints out of the layout and back, then a rebuild that pins the shot
set-build.test.js.reason: PRE-EXISTING: fails in film-engine at the pinned commit too

production-graph-nodes.test.js.name: every picture or clip a pg* function draws goes through pgSrc/pgThumb, so it reaches the API origin
production-graph-nodes.test.js.reason: PRE-EXISTING: fails in film-engine at fb8c770 too (its scanner flags pgDrawerVersion: esc(auditionUrl), but auditionUrl is built with pgSrc one line up)

page-handlers.test.js.name: the delivery pages reach every field their routes accept
page-handlers.test.js.reason: reads the legacy saver functions (saveCredit, saveTitleCard, saveSubtitle, saveRight) out of the page script; those pages are React now. The same guarantee, derived from the same routes, runs in src/pages/delivery-fields.test.jsx: it SAVES each React form and reads the request body, and holds a page still legacy (deliverables) to this test's own rule against its chunk.

page-handlers.test.js.name: no page handler calls a loader that does not exist
page-handlers.test.js.reason: reads the assembled page, where a React page's loader (loadScenes) is only a placeholder var while core still calls it. The same rule, over every legacy file AND the React pages' registered loaders, runs in tools/tests/react-pages.test.js.

screenplay-drift.test.js.name: the scenes page shows drift beside the status, not instead of it
screenplay-drift.test.js.reason: reads sceneDriftBadge/sceneDriftBanner/loadScenes out of the page script; the Scenes page is React. src/pages/scenes/ScenesPage.test.jsx holds the same: drift is loaded with the scenes, the badge sits BESIDE the status badge, the banner is shown.

screenplay-drift.test.js.name: the page says what re-running the breakdown actually does
screenplay-drift.test.js.reason: reads sceneDriftBanner's text out of the page script; the Scenes page is React. src/pages/scenes/ScenesPage.test.jsx holds the same text on the rendered banner AND that routes/breakdown.js still skips a scene with shots.

grid-children.test.js.name: the scan sees the grids and the writes into them
grid-children.test.js.reason: asserts at least 3 legacy innerHTML writes into .entity-grid containers; the pages that made them (assets, moodboard) are React and render their grids as components. The rule itself (every grid child is a card or spans the row) is enforced on EVERY React test's rendered output by the afterEach in src/test/setup.js (gridChildProblems).

mood-board-images.test.js.name: the page renders the served URL, and does not hide a failure in silence
mood-board-images.test.js.reason: reads loadMoodBoardPage out of the page script; the Mood Board is React. src/pages/moodboard/MoodBoardPage.test.jsx holds the same on the rendered page: the is built from image_url through plateSrc, and a failed load is replaced by a message, not hidden.

edits.test.js.name: the page: an Edit page in Post, the score monitor follows the playhead, and a session can be opened on an edit
edits.test.js.reason: REACT: reads function loadEditsPage( and friends out of the page script; the Edit page is React (src/pages/edits). Every guarantee is held in src/pages/edits/edits-contract.test.jsx (nav item, loader, X-Upload-Offset, the music workstation half) and EditsPage.test.jsx (behaviour).

style-book-media.test.js.name: the page can add a visual — both ways
style-book-media.test.js.reason: reads addStyleBookMedia/removeStyleBookMedia/link_kind out of the page script; the Style Book is React. src/pages/stylebook/StyleBookPage.test.jsx adds by link and by file (size-checked), removes, and checks each visual is drawn as what it is (embed, clip, link, picture).

style-book-media.test.js.name: a brand-new shot offers the visual fields, and saves itself to accept one
style-book-media.test.js.reason: reads the legacy modal's mediaSection wiring; the Style Book is React. src/pages/stylebook/StyleBookPage.test.jsx opens + Shot, finds the visual fields, and checks Add visual saves the shot first, then attaches, keeping the editor open.

style-book.test.js.name: the page exists and is reachable from the rail
style-book.test.js.reason: reads function loadStyleBook and applyStyleBookEntry out of the page script; both are React now (applyStyleBookEntry is PROVIDED on window, react.json). src/pages/stylebook/StyleBookPage.test.jsx checks the rail entry, the page, and applying (including on a fresh app, the bug the port had); tools/tests/react-pages.test.js checks both are registered.

style-book-gaps.test.js.name: the reference-slot reality reaches both surfaces, from ONE source
style-book-gaps.test.js.reason: reads styleBookNoteInto/openStyleBookModal out of the page script; the Style Book is React. src/pages/stylebook/StyleBookPage.test.jsx checks the served note is painted where visuals are added and that the page holds no copy of it.

style-book-gaps.test.js.name: the style-book entry card is in the wrapping-row denominator
style-book-gaps.test.js.reason: reads renderStyleBook's template; the Style Book is React. src/pages/stylebook/StyleBookPage.test.jsx checks every rendered entry is an .entity-card with its own .card-actions row.
